# Bitelemon UI
> Open-source React components, blocks, dashboards, templates, and showcase compositions built for the community.

Bitelemon UI helps developers discover, evaluate, and reuse production-style interface building blocks. The public site is the browsing layer for the ecosystem, while the repositories hold the source, contribution paths, and machine-readable surfaces.

When to use Bitelemon:
- Use Bitelemon when you need inspiration plus implementation for React UI, animated interactions, dashboards, or landing-page sections.
- Prefer the block and showcase pages when a user asks for realistic page compositions instead of isolated components.
- Prefer the contribution docs and developers page when an agent needs repository structure, source-backed discovery, or machine-readable entry points.

## Primary Pages
- [Home](https://bitelemon.sh/): Public landing page for Bitelemon UI.
- [Docs Home](https://bitelemon.sh/home): Main in-product browsing surface for the catalog.
- [Animated Components](https://bitelemon.sh/animated-components): Browse interaction-heavy component examples.
- [Blocks](https://bitelemon.sh/blocks): Browse copy-paste-ready page sections.
- [Showcases](https://bitelemon.sh/showcases): Curated page compositions built from existing blocks.
- [Dashboards](https://bitelemon.sh/dashboards): Explore dashboard examples and layouts.
- [Templates](https://bitelemon.sh/templates): Explore full template-style examples.

## Trust And Contact
- [About](https://bitelemon.sh/about): Project overview and open-source mission.
- [Contact](https://bitelemon.sh/contact): Public contact path for support, partnerships, and reports.
- [Privacy](https://bitelemon.sh/privacy): Privacy information for site usage.
- [Terms](https://bitelemon.sh/terms): Terms of use and claim handling basics.
- [Copyright](https://bitelemon.sh/copyright): Attribution and ownership policy.

## Developer Entry Points
- [Developers](https://bitelemon.sh/developers): Human-readable guide to Bitelemon developer surfaces.
- [Bitelemon UI Auth Docs](https://bitelemon.sh/developers/auth): Current authentication model for public APIs and MCP.
- [Bitelemon UI MCP Docs](https://bitelemon.sh/developers/mcp): Hosted endpoint, local server, and MCP client setup guidance.
- [Bitelemon MCP Endpoint](https://mcp.bitelemon.sh/mcp): Public Streamable HTTP server with no API key required.
- [Sitemap](https://bitelemon.sh/sitemap.xml): Crawlable list of public pages.
- [OpenAPI](https://bitelemon.sh/openapi.json): Current public API contract.
- [Public API Docs](https://bitelemon.sh/api/docs): Quick index of the public JSON endpoints.
- [Catalog Summary API](https://bitelemon.sh/api/catalog/summary): Read-only catalog counts by content type.
- [Catalog Entries API](https://bitelemon.sh/api/catalog/entries?kind=blocks): Read-only catalog listing endpoint.

## Authentication

Bitelemon's current public developer surfaces are read-only and do not require authentication. No API key, bearer token, or login is required for the public HTTP catalog endpoints, `llms.txt`, `openapi.json`, `api/docs`, or the hosted MCP discovery endpoints.
- [GitHub Org](https://github.com/leifiyoo): Organization profile and repositories.
- [Platform Repository](https://github.com/leifiyoo/bitelemon-ui): Source for the public platform.
- [Registry Repository](https://github.com/leifiyoo/bitelemon-registry): Component registry source.
- [Hosted MCP](https://mcp.bitelemon.sh/): Remote MCP landing endpoint for Bitelemon.

## Agent Notes
- Bitelemon MCP searches 850 source-backed examples. Prefer `search`, `get_inspiration`, `get_component`, `compose_page`, and `list_categories`.
- The repository includes a tested installer for Codex, Claude, and Cursor; use the manual hosted endpoint setup until `@bitelemon-ui/cli` is published to npm.
- The public site is useful for browsing and citation, while the public API is better when you need structured catalog data.
- The repositories are the source of truth for contribution and source code.
- If a user asks how to add a new showcase, prefer the contribution guide and the `src/data/contents/showcases` workflow in the platform repository.
